uncertainObservations: The glowing points: I can resolve four around the inner ring plus one brighter glow at the exact center. Whether the center glow is a fifth staff tip or simply the hub of the inscribed pattern is not determinable, so the staff-tip-to-glow mapping is uncertain even though I am reasonably confident there are five figures and five staffs.
The bottom-center figure's staff runs to the viewer-right and its tip overlaps the lower-right glow; I cannot fully separate it from the mid-right figure's staff where they cross.
The exact shape of the staff tips (plain, budded, bladed) is lost in the glare of the glow.
The two pale spheres in the sky could be planets or moons; I cannot resolve a phase on either and will not name one.
The circular form inside the pavilion at upper-left reads as a large spoked wheel but is small and dark.
The upright at lower viewer-left could be a cross, a grave marker, or a sword planted point-down; the crossbar is visible but the lower end is buried.
I cannot read any facial features on any of the five figures; all are backlit or in shadow.
Figure genders are not determinable and I have not assigned any.
